in_marathi.name: Vikramaditya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikramaditya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vikramaditya is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Vikram', which means 'to conquer', and 'Aditya', which means 'sun'. Thus, Vikramaditya means 'conqueror of the sun' or 'sun god'. This powerful name was given to several Hindu rulers throughout history, who were believed to have divine right to rule and were often equated with the sun god.
